source_detail: Regenerate: columns indexed by x in GF(2)^5; for each c in [6582, 20458, 26495, 7928, 21330, 8844, 19097, 609, 17627, 25488, 16514, 30214, 4924] take the 3x5 GF(2) matrix L_c with entry (r,b) = bit 5r+b of c, and for each t in 0..7 add the row x -> int(L_c x) XOR t (bit r of the symbol = row r of L_c x, bit b of x = coordinate b); then add the 8 constant rows. 13*8 + 8 = 112 rows
construction: Z_2^3-developed linear starters: 13 linear maps GF(2)^5 -> GF(2)^3, each developed over its 8 XOR translates, plus 8 constant rows; for every nonzero w in GF(2)^5 the values L_c(w) cover all 7 nonzero differences
